In a claymation style, a young-adult-appearing man with light skin tone and curly, light-colored clay hair emerges from beneath a wide-brimmed clay hat. The hat's crown is striped with cheerful orange and white clay, and it has a vibrant red clay brim outlined in yellow clay. He wears a clay tunic vertically divided into a blue section with a yellow sleeve on the viewer's left, and a red section with a blue sleeve on the viewer's right. A yellow and blue clay belt encircles his waist. His legs are clad in blue clay tights, and his shoes are red clay.

The man holds a thin, golden-yellow clay object in his raised right hand. His left hand rests on a light brown clay wooden table with four legs. On the table are arranged: a golden clay cup, a red clay cup, several golden clay coins or discs, two clay knives (one with a black handle and one with a white handle), and a clay pouch or bag.

The background is a simple clay landscape with a light yellow clay ground, a small green clay plant or bush, and a slightly darker yellow clay horizon line. The scene is framed by a black clay border. At the top is the Roman numeral "I" in black clay centered below the word "TAROT" in smaller, centered, sans-serif black clay letters. At the bottom, "EL MAGO" is written in bold, uppercase, sans-serif black clay letters. The light is golden and warm, bathing the scene in a gentle glow.
